gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2   -c -o hlfp_common.o hlfp_common.c
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2   -c -o hlfp_smd.o hlfp_smd.c
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2   -c -o hlfp_mdl.o hlfp_mdl.c
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2   -c -o hlfp_math.o hlfp_math.c
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2   -c -o hlfp_blend.o hlfp_blend.c
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2   -c -o hlfp_compile.o hlfp_compile.c
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2   -c -o hlfp_detach.o hlfp_detach.c
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2   -c -o hlfp_ctrlquat.o hlfp_ctrlquat.c
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2   -c -o hlfp_reemit.o hlfp_reemit.c
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2   -c -o hlfp_goldsrc.o hlfp_goldsrc.c
ar rcs libhlfp.a hlfp_common.o hlfp_smd.o hlfp_mdl.o hlfp_math.o hlfp_blend.o hlfp_compile.o hlfp_detach.o hlfp_ctrlquat.o hlfp_reemit.o hlfp_goldsrc.o
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2 -o test_hlfp test_hlfp.c libhlfp.a
gcc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2 -o test_hlfp_goldsrc test_hlfp_goldsrc.c libhlfp.a
./test_hlfp > test_output.txt
./test_hlfp_goldsrc >> test_output.txt
